title: LFSR routed through a user-defined function (regression fence for user-fn reactivity)
problemDescription: 8-bit LFSR (same taps as 029-lfsr: 7,5,4,3) but the shift+xor step is wrapped in a user-declared function step(v). Pre-fix (memory project_user_fn_reactivity_gap), the interpreter evaluated step(state) at parse time and baked the result into a static Variable — subsequent process re-fires kept re-pushing that frozen value, so q transitioned once from 00000001 to 00000010 then stayed there forever. Fix: DeferredUserFunction wrapper (Interpreter/Models/DeferredUserFunction.cs) + Execute() branch + ShuntingYard allowlist. If this case regresses to a single q transition (all-zero mismatches from t=25ns onward), the fix has been broken.
